name: Vinali Bhatnagar
bio: Vinali Bhatnagar is an actress and model from Bhopal, India. She's known for her roles in Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan (2023), Yasser Desai: Qafile Noor Ke (2020), and The Kapil Sharma Show (2016). Bhatnagar has a master's degree in fashion management from the London School of Fashion and has been passionate about fashion since childhood. She's also a trained Kathak dancer and gymnast.

credits.title: Sri Sri
credits.overview: He loved a girl with no past and gave her a future... Now destiny returns to take her back, steeped in a forgotten life, buried memories and claims he cannot disprove.
